en.t: How rude of you to ask so much.
I had the hardest time of all my sisters.

units.source_text: 回想起来，我长大成人时，正好家境困难。”

en.t: When I think back on it, just as I was growing up, things at home were hard.

units.source_text: 她自言自语地说过之后，又突然提高嗓门：“如果女佣带着惊异的神色问我：‘驹姐，你什么时候来的？’

en.t: After saying this as if to herself, she suddenly raised her voice again: If the maid looks surprised and asks me, Komako, when did you come?

units.source_text: 我总不能三番五次地躲在壁橱里呀。

en.t: I can hardly keep hiding in the closet again and again.
I cannot sleep, so I want to wash my hair.

units.source_text: 早晨不洗，要等头发干了才能去梳头师那儿，就赶不上午宴的时间了。

en.t: If I do not wash it in the morning, I have to wait for it to dry before going to the hairdresser, and then I will miss the noon banquet.

units.source_text: 虽然这儿也有宴会，但到了晚上才派人来告诉我，我已经答应别人了，不能来了。

en.t: There is a banquet here too, but they only sent someone to tell me in the evening, and I had already accepted another engagement, so I cannot come.

units.source_text: 今儿是星期六，特别忙，不能来玩了。”

en.t: Today is Saturday, so I am especially busy and cannot come over to visit.

units.source_text: 驹子虽然这么说，但却没有站起来要走的意思。

en.t: Komako said this, but she showed no sign of getting up to leave.
